questions.answer: Google translate

questions.answer: Had two courses that overlapped so that i couldnt take one, other than that it went well.

questions.answer: Get a coffee and some snacks maybe and try not to loose your mind.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Lectures was very slow compared to at UCPH. Corricilum for each course was also smaller so it matched. Some exams were rather hard still so good with some challenge.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Very slow paced, not as much self work at the sessions, pen and paper instead of computer at the exam.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Corporate Finance
Behavioral and Experimental Economics
Environmental and ressource Economics
Public Economics
Advanced Microeconomics
Économie du climat
Development Economics

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Environmental ones were good. Public was challenging but good.

questions.answer: Sport, winetastings, museums and stuff. I was happy with the winetastings

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: AEGEE Winetastings. You taste wine and meet a lot of people.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: 1 euro train in all occitanie the first weekend of each month. So go around the region. Go ski in pyrenees. Go to Spain.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Go to place saint piere and drink pastis.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: People are slow and late for appointments.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The language, food and dance.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Go to AEGEE events or ESN. Make dinners with other exchange students. Rent a car and go on roadtrip with other exchange students.
